before_times: the first name of the parent booking
a new family or a current one
which visit: the office's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
where the visit is: at the office, by video, or at home (home visits only inside the business's area)
a plan (its name only) or self-pay
after_time: anything the consultant should know to help, like needing an interpreter
the parent's name and mobile (for texts)
secure_page_only: how the person booking is related to the baby
the plan's member ID, the plan holder and a photo of the plan card
the feeding history and the health history
the consents and the privacy notice
intake_questions.never_asked: feeding problems, symptoms, weights and test results are never asked or typed in the AI chat
intake_questions.who_may_book: a parent or guardian, or a support person the parent names on the secure page; a baby never books
intake_questions.who_may_bring: a parent or guardian brings the baby; another adult only with the parent's signed OK on the secure page

stop.words: trouble breathing, a seizure, a baby who isn't breathing, a baby who is blue or won't wake up, or heavy bleeding
stop.say: Call 911 now. Rosie can't book care for an emergency.
stop.booking: no booking; any visit stays booked

stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the person isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.

stop.words: thoughts of harming yourself or the baby, or a crisis after the birth
stop.say: Call or text 988 now. If you are in danger, call 911. The consultant is told.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words in a later text get 988 again

go_on.words: a feeding question with nothing on the lists above
go_on.where: matched to the consultant's own visit: Rosie never judges how serious it is

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: The feeding history, the health history and the consent
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due before the first visit; one reminder before it's due
steps.result: not done by its due date: the consultant keeps the visit (signed on the secure page first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand
steps.who: every family that names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the family may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for a self-pay family
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day
steps.result: a to-do for the office, with its due date

steps.name: The owner's OK for a new family
steps.when: before the first visit is booked
steps.result: OK: booked; no: told kindly, nothing kept

first_steps_and_forms.prep: arrive 10 minutes early; bring the plan card and the feeding log, if the family has one; a parent comes with the baby; at home: a clear place to sit

staff.skills: lactation consultants: office and home visits, video visits and weight checks; only consultants the owner clears go to homes
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each consultant's own certification, if the owner adds it (optional; never checked by Rosie)
staff.supervision: a consultant in training works with a certified consultant, as the owner says (the owner's note, not checked)
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs a new family's first visit, and any visit a consultant flags
staff.stand_in: a consultant out: the backup consultant the family has met may take the visit, with the family's yes; nobody is moved without it

children_and_age.who_may_book: a parent or guardian, or a support person the parent names on the secure page; a baby never books
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts go to the parent or guardian; nothing about a baby is texted to anyone else
children_and_age.minors_rules: a minor's booking follows the owner's rule; until it's set, a parent or guardian books

visit.check_in: at the office: the check-in code at the front desk; a video visit: the code read out at the start; at home: the code from the parent at the door
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the consultant's notes stay with the consultant, never in Rosie or a text; a follow-up is booked at checkout
visit.changes_at_visit: a second visit or a test is added only with the parent's yes, with any price first
visit.before_work: the consultant asks how feeding is going and looks at the baby's weight, before the visit's work starts

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: optional, and never verified by Rosie: a consultant may add a lactation certification it holds (IBCLC or similar), and the business may add a registration; Rosie looks nothing up and never says anything is checked
license.who: the business says what it holds; the owner adds each consultant's own number on the secure page
license.ask: each consultant's certification number, if they hold one, in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
license.insurance: liability insurance, if the owner adds it: a note only, never checked

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the business's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the feeding, the baby's weight, symptoms or results (at a home visit the consultant's name stays, for the door check)
languages: English and Spanish; the secure page asks if the family needs an interpreter, and the business is told
